_comment: GOLDEN FIXTURE A — backtest Run 2 CORRECTED (docs/backtests/BACKTEST-2026-07-15.md). Pins the with-spine (J2 variant a) + our-side core handoff (J3 default) variant of the 2-rack dual design. Diff semantics per Phase 1 Amendment 3: structured essentials only — category, line identity (merge-key/model match), qty. Never full note/PN strings.
migrationNote: Phase 2: when the J2/J3 inputs land (INPUT-SCHEMA.md §1.4), add uplinkTarget:'new-spine' and coreHandoff:'our-side' to `input` below so this fixture keeps pinning the SAME variant instead of drifting with whatever default those inputs get. A separate fixture-A2 (spine-less: no S5232F line, no leaf-to-spine AOCs, uplinks terminate at the core handoff) is added at that time.
name: Fixture A — 60x R660/R760, 10GBase-T 2-port, 2 racks, dual (VLT/MC-LAG pair per rack)

expected.label: leaf switches — 2 per rack as a redundant pair x 2 racks
spine — own line, never merged into the leaf line
OOB switches — one per DECLARED rack (2, not 3 — no phantom spine rack)
host cabling — exactly 1 Cat6A per link, 120 links
redundant-pair interconnect (VLT ICL / MC-LAG peer link per J1) — 2 links x 2 pairs = 4x 100G DAC
leaf-to-spine uplinks — 2 per leaf x 4 leaves = 8 links, 1 AOC per link
OOB cabling within-rack — 60 hosts + 6 switch mgmt ports (4 leaf + 2 spine; OOB switches managed via console/in-band, NOT self-cabled — ruling 2026-07-16)
OOB inter-rack uplinks — 1 per rack x 2
inter-network transceivers — our side only, 1 per port x 2
inter-network patch cords — 2 per link x 2 links
